text: dsh-review-panel 是面向 DSH Web 与桌面客户端的代码审查插件，在官方右侧栏提供只读审查页，并在聊天输入区加入本轮修改入口。它通过 DSH 工作区变更记录、文件服务和 Git 数据展示完整源码与行级内联差异，可比较 Agent 本轮、未提交改动及任意历史版本。页面还提供文件树、编辑器标签、工作区搜索、快速打开，以及语言服务的定义跳转、引用查找、悬停和大纲。适合希望在 DSH 会话中集中检查代码变更的开发者。安装需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 或更高；Git 与语言服务器为可选本地能力，不需要 API Key。

dsh-review-panel adds a read-only code review page to DSH’s right sidebar. It shows full files with inline diffs for agent turns, uncommitted work, and Git revisions, plus a file tree, workspace search, and language-server navigation. Git and language servers are optional.

dsh-review-panel 的功能「会话代码审查」：在右侧栏打开审查页，按文件查看当前轮变更与源码差异。可从侧栏标签或聊天输入区的本轮修改入口打开。
dsh-review-panel 的功能「Git 版本对比」：查看未提交或历史修订的文件差异，也可浏览提交版本。用户在审查页选择 Git 对比基线并选定版本。
dsh-review-panel 的功能「工作区搜索」：在当前工作区建立有界文件索引并搜索文件内容，结果可用于定位要审查的源码。通过审查页面的搜索入口触发。
dsh-review-panel 的功能「语言服务导航」：在支持的语言文件中请求定义、引用、悬停信息和符号大纲；打开文件并使用导航命令或编辑器交互查看结果。
dsh-review-panel 的使用前须知：Git 对比和语言服务导航依赖本机可用的 Git 与受支持语言服务器；缺少时相应功能不可用或会降级。

dsh-review-panel README · 这是什么：`dsh-review-panel` 把 **Cursor 式的代码审查体验**带进 DeepSeek Harness：在官方右侧栏里加一个只读的「代码审查」页，用完整源码 + 行级内联 diff 展示 Agent 本轮、Git 未提交或任意历史版本改了什么，并把常用的 **VS Code 快捷键操作**搬了过来。

DSH 自带的审查是一个个 hunk 片段；这个插件给的是**整个文件**——新增行整行着色，删除行按原行号内联显示，配合文件树、编辑器标签页和键盘操作，像在编辑器里 review 一样。

dsh-review-panel README · 这是什么：- **完整源码 + 行级内联 diff**：新增行整行着色，删除行内联保留原行号
- **四种对比基线**：`Agent 本轮` / `Git 未提交` / `任意 Git 版本` / `仅代码`，一键切换
- **任意 Git 版本 diff**：选中任意历史提交（也可输入分支、标签、`HEAD~2` 等版本引用），直接查看那次提交引入的改动；也能切换到「自该版本以来」查看该版本到当前工作区的累计改动。推送之后再回头 review 上一轮改动尤其方便
- **VS Code 式工作区**：文件树、编辑器标签页、Quick Open（Ctrl+P）、命令面板、工作区搜索
- **语言服务导航**：F12 跳转定义、Shift+F12 查找引用、悬停提示、文档大纲、只读诊断
- **只读安全**：不写文件、不提交 Git、不静默安装任何东西；需要操作时交给 DSH Agent
- **自动跟随 DSH 明暗主题**

dsh-review-panel README · v0.3.1 · 历史版本 Git diff：现在可以直接在代码审查页里按**任意历史 Git 版本** review 改动了：

- **历史版本 Git diff**：对比基线下拉菜单新增「最新提交」和「Git 版本…」。选中任意提交、分支、标签或 `HEAD~2` 这类版本引用，就能用完整源码 + 行级内联 diff 看那次提交改了什么；切换到「自该版本以来」还能看该版本到当前工作区的累计改动。push 之后回头 review 上一轮尤其方便。
- **历史版本也能用语言服务导航**：在历史版本里同样支持 `F12` 跳转定义、`Shift+F12` 查找引用、悬停提示和文档大纲，跨文件跳转会打开目标文件在该版本中的内容。（历史快照下不显示诊断标记，避免旧快照与当前工作区混用产生误报；切回工作区基线后自动恢复。）
- **切换会话保留审查现场**：切到别的会话或右侧栏标签再切回来，之前打开的文件标签、当前文件和所选对比基线（包括具体选中的 Git 版本）都会保留，不用重新打开一遍。

dsh-review-panel README · 查看历史 Git 版本的改动：审查页工具栏上有对比基线下拉菜单，除了 `Agent 本轮` 和 `Git 未提交`，还可以按任意 Git 版本对比：

- **最新提交**：一键查看最近一次提交（`HEAD`）引入的改动。刚 push 完想 review 上一轮时，直接点它即可。
- **Git 版本…**：打开提交历史列表（显示 sha、提交说明、分支/标签与时间）。选中一个提交后：
  - **该版本改动**（默认）：展示该提交相对上一版本（第一父提交）引入的改动，即使工作区已经干净或又有了新提交，也能准确回看那一轮。
  - **自该版本以来**：展示该版本到当前工作区的累计改动，包含已提交、已暂存、未暂存和新增文件。
  - 列表下方的输入框也可以直接输入任意版本引用（完整/短 sha、分支、标签、`HEAD~2` 等）。

历史版本的内容来自 Git：`F12`、查找引用、悬停与文档大纲由语言服务器基于该快照文本工作，跨文件跳转会打开目标文件在当前选中版本中的内容（行号取自工作区当前版本，可能略有偏移）；为避免旧快照与新工作区混用产生误报，该模式下不显示诊断标记。切回工作区相关基线后诊断自动恢复。

dsh-review-panel README · What is this：`dsh-review-panel` brings a **Cursor-style code review experience** to DeepSeek Harness. It adds a read-only **Code Review** tab to the official right sidebar, showing what changed in this agent turn, in the uncommitted worktree or in any historical git version as full source files with line-level inline diffs — and it brings the **VS Code shortcuts** you already know.

dsh-review-panel README · What is this：DSH's builtin review shows one hunk at a time; this panel gives you the **whole file** — added lines tinted across the full row, deleted lines kept inline with their original line numbers — plus a file tree, editor tabs and keyboard-driven navigation, so reviewing feels like working in an editor.

dsh-review-panel README · What is this：- **Full source + inline line-level diffs** — added lines tinted, deleted lines inline with original line numbers
- **Four diff baselines** — `Agent turn` / `Git uncommitted` / `Any git version` / `Code only`, switchable in one click
- **Diff against any git version** — pick any historical commit (or type a branch, tag, `HEAD~2`, …) and review exactly what that commit changed; switch to "changes since this version" to see the cumulative diff up to the current worktree. Especially handy for reviewing the last round right after pushing
- **VS Code-style workspace** — file tree, editor tabs, Quick Open (`Ctrl+P`), command palette, workspace search
- **Language-server navigation** — `F12` definition, `Shift+F12` references, hover, document outline, read-only diagnostics
- **Read-only by design** — never writes files, never runs git mutations, never installs anything silently
- **Follows the DSH light/dark theme automatically**
dsh-review-panel README · v0.3.1 · Historical git diffs：You can now review changes against **any historical git version** right inside the Code Review page:

dsh-review-panel README · v0.3.1 · Historical git diffs：- **Diff against any git version** — the baseline dropdown now offers **Latest commit** and **Git version…**. Pick any commit, branch, tag or revision expression such as `HEAD~2` and review exactly what it changed with full source and line-level inline diffs; switch to **Changes since this version** to see the cumulative diff from that version up to the current worktree. Especially handy for reviewing the last round right after pushing.
- **Language-server navigation works on historical versions** — `F12` go-to-definition, `Shift+F12` references, hover and the document outline all work on the snapshot; a cross-file jump opens the target file at that version. (Diagnostics stay hidden there so an old snapshot is never mixed with the current worktree; they come back on the worktree baselines.)
- **Your review workspace survives session switches** — switch to another conversation or sidebar tab and come back: the open files, active tab and selected diff baseline (including the picked git version) are still there.

dsh-review-panel README · Review changes from a historical git version：- **Latest commit**: one click to review what the most recent commit (`HEAD`) changed. Right after a push, this is exactly the last round's diff.
- **Git version…**: opens the commit history (sha, subject, branch/tag refs and date). After you pick a commit:
  - **This version's diff** (default) — what that commit introduced relative to its previous version (first parent). Works even when the worktree is clean or has moved on.
  - **Changes since this version** — the cumulative diff from that version up to the current worktree (committed, staged, unstaged and untracked changes included).
  - The input below the list also accepts any revision expression (full/short sha, branch, tag, `HEAD~2`, …).
section: Review changes from a historical git version

text: dsh-review-panel README · Review changes from a historical git version：Historical content comes from git. `F12`, find references, hover and the document outline keep working on that snapshot text (a cross-file jump opens the target file at the selected version; its line number comes from the current worktree and may be off); diagnostics stay hidden in this mode so an old snapshot is never mixed with the current project. Worktree baselines restore diagnostics automatically.

text: dsh-review-panel README · Session switching：The review page remembers each conversation's workspace state: after switching sessions and back, the open files, tabs and diff baseline (including the selected git version) are still there instead of being reset.

dsh-review-panel README · Shortcuts：Every command is registered through DSH's official shortcuts service, so all of them can be rebound in **Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts**. On macOS, use `Cmd` instead of `Ctrl`; a chord the OS already owns may show as unbound, in which case rebind it in Settings.
